name: Horton Center
operator_name: New Hampshire Conference, United Church of Christ
description_short: Overnight church camp on Pine Mountain near Gorham in the White Mountains, run by the New Hampshire Conference of the United Church of Christ. Kids entering grades 3 to 12 come for week long sessions grouped by grade, with hiking, caving, rock climbing, swimming, archery and crafts alongside daily chapel and open faith discussion.
special_needs_notes: Families should tell the directors about any physical, emotional or behavioral needs before registering by contacting the executive director. The camp says it cannot serve every need but tries to support as many campers as it can.

sessions.name: Week 1: HC Serves (grades 3 to 12 and adults)
Week 2: Middlers on the Mountain (grades 6 to 8)
Week 2: Senior High, Choose Your Own Adventure (grades 9 to 12)
Week 5: Hogwarts on the Mountain (grades 4 to 6)
Week 7: Pride on the Mountain (grades 7 to 12)

notes: Each session has three voluntary price tiers and families choose one: week long sessions are $750, $620 or $545, and shorter sessions $330, $285 or $240. Session prices shown are the top (whole cost) tier. A $100 deposit holds a spot. Check in is usually Sunday 2 to 4 pm and pickup Saturday 9 am. The off season office is at 140 Sheep Davis Road, Pembroke.
